title: A dramatic event at the end of the Ice Age wiped out North American megafauna

tellings.quote: I guarantee you that the North Atlantic ice cap and this dramatic event that that inst I say instantly but rapidly ended the ice age. I mean it eviscerated North America.

plain: A dramatic event linked to the North Atlantic ice cap ended the Ice Age, not instantly but rapidly, and "eviscerated" North America, killing off its large animals. That is the claim of the researcher Luke Caverns, who tells Michels he would "guarantee" it, drawing on an evolutionary biologist he does not name. If true, a sudden catastrophe, not a slow change, would have reshaped the continent's life at the end of the Ice Age.
